proposal_identity.provenance: Newly authored reconstruction candidate; not recovered GP V1.1 and not an authoritative historical parameter set.

formal_boundary.scoring_scope: Formal-only through the inclusive formal_end date
formal_boundary.probability_scope: Independently labelled Formal-only rows available by the query as_of

policy.portfolio_context: Fresh paper portfolio; no existing holdings are assumed.

execution_contract.blocked_entry_behavior: No assumed execution when suspended, non-tradable, or at the upper limit
execution_contract.fill_validation: A future approved backtest executor must validate all fills; this scorer does not implement fill simulation.

cost_assumption.application: Proposal for a future approved backtest executor; no cost is calculated by this scorer.

probability_mapping.smoothing: Add one to UP, DOWN, and FLAT counts
probability_mapping.label_definition: Close-to-close signed return from T to T+h market-calendar trading sessions: UP greater than zero, DOWN less than zero, FLAT equal to zero. Suspended or missing target closes are excluded, never shifted to a later bar.
probability_mapping.label_collection: External; separate provenance verification is required.
